Derivation of pressure exerted by gas
Average translational kinetic energy of gas molecule

agentNotes: Authoring contract: frontend/AGENTS.md §9 (extra unit card). Exam bank: kinetic-theory assumptions (2023), O2 rms at 27 C (2022), Charles-volume numerical (2022).

card.title: Exam bank — every board question on ideal gas

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Three questions: kinetic-theory assumptions (2023, 5 marks), rms speed of O2 at 27 C (2022: ~484 m/s), Charles-law volume change (2022: 0.5 m3 at 27 C to 100 C gives ~0.62 m3). Pressure is molecular bombardment; temperature is mean translational KE (3kT/2 per molecule).

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: PV = nRT = NkT · P = rho c-bar2/3 · KE per molecule = 3kT/2 · c_rms = sqrt(3RT/M) · O2 300 K: ~484 m/s

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Ideal behaviour needs point molecules, elastic collisions, no forces, huge N (meaning averages stay sharp). Assumptions question demands the full list — each missing postulate costs. Charles numerical needs kelvin (300 K to 373 K) and constant pressure.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Same T means same molecular KE for every gas (rms then sorts by mass: H2 outruns O2). Heat capacities split Cp - Cv = R. Real gases deviate at high P/low T (van der Waals corrects volume and attraction).

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2022 (3): c_rms = sqrt(3 x 8.31 x 300/0.032) = sqrt(2.34x10^5) ~ 484 m/s. NEB 2022 (4): V2 = 0.5 x 373/300 ~ 0.62 m3 at constant P. NEB 2023 (5): assumptions list (large N, point mass, elastic, no forces, random motion).

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: Celsius in gas laws; M in g/mol inside sqrt(3RT/M) (needs kg/mol); rms confused with mean/most-probable. Model ignores vibrations/rotations and quantum effects.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Pressure derivation: one molecule's kicks (2mvx per hit, hit rate vx/2L) summed over N with isotropy (vx-bar2 = c-bar2/3) gives P = rho c-bar2/3; with rho = Nm/V, PV = NkT identifies temperature with molecular energy.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: 'State assumptions' means the five-postulate list. rms: kelvin plus kg/mol, always. Charles: V1/T1 = V2/T2 with T in kelvin. KE per molecule 3kT/2, per mole 3RT/2.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2023 (5): kinetic theory + assumptions. NEB 2022 (3): O2 rms at 27 C. NEB 2022 (4): 0.5 m3 at 27 C to 100 C constant-P volume.
